_comment: Reference values for qe-output-parse (real pw.x 7.4 SCF of a 2-atom Si cell, displaced off symmetry, ecutwfc=40 Ry, 4x4x4 shifted k-grid, mv smearing 0.02). Sample artifacts generated by really running pw.x inside this task's image (environment/generate_assets.sh). Calibrated on x86_64.
_calibration_note: QE 7.4 from conda-forge (channel carries no 7.3.1; 7.4 is the closest 7.x release), PSlibrary 1.0.0 Si.pbe-n-rrkjus_psl UPF. 5 generation runs produced identical parsed values (spread 0 at print resolution). Tolerances follow the print precision of each quantity: energy printed to 1e-8 Ry (tol 1e-6, covers agents reading the full-precision XML etot in Ha), total force printed to 1e-6 Ry/bohr (tol 1e-5), Fermi energy printed to 1e-4 eV (tol 5e-3, covers agents converting the full-precision XML fermi from Ha). Cross-verify for this analysis task: verifier re-parses the hash-verified artifacts and requires exact agreement with refs, then compares the agent's values to refs.
